effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` EURe (0x3231…273f) to the vault through transferFrom, which spends the signer's EURe allowance to the vault.
The vault mints ERY shares to `receiver`. The share count comes from the exchange rate after fee accrual, rounded down, and has no minimum bound.
The vault supplies the EURe to Morpho Blue markets in its supply queue. This is internal to the vault.
formats.shown: Deposit: the EURe amount, the 'Share ticker' ERY, and 'Send shares to' the receiver.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many ERY shares the receiver gets; the vault's exchange rate decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` The deposit fields show only `assets` and `Share ticker` ERY. The share count is not in calldata and has no minimum.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' names neither the EURe sent nor the ERY vault shares received.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: "intent": "Deposit", with no interpolatedIntent. The asset and the receiver are only in the fields.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit EURe into ERY vault".

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` ERY to `receiver`.
The signer pays an EURe amount that the vault computes from the shares, rounded up after fee accrual. transferFrom takes it from the signer, bounded only by the signer's allowance.
The vault supplies the EURe to Morpho Blue markets. This is internal to the vault.
formats.shown: Mint: 'Deposit asset' EURe as a ticker only, 'Minted shares' as an ERY amount, and 'Mint shares to' the receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show the EURe amount it takes from the signer; storage-based exchange rate decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` The 'Deposit asset' field is a raw constant: "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker". No calldata value bounds the EURe taken.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that EURe leaves the signer's wallet.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: "intent": "Mint". The only payment hint is the field 'Deposit asset' with the value 'EURe'. ERC4626._deposit runs `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit EURe to mint ERY shares".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns ERY shares from `owner`. The vault computes the number from `assets`, rounded up after fee accrual.
If the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's ERY allowance from `owner` by that number of shares.
The vault sends exactly `assets` EURe to `receiver` after it withdraws them from Morpho Blue markets.
formats.shown: Withdraw: 'Withdraw exactly' with the EURe amount, 'To' the receiver, and the 'Owner' of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many ERY shares it burns from the owner; the exchange rate decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` then ERC4626._withdraw runs `_burn(owner, shares)`. The withdraw fields show only `assets`, `receiver` and `owner`.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` ERY from `owner`.
If the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's ERY allowance from `owner` by `shares`.
The vault sends EURe to `receiver`. The amount is computed from the shares, rounded down, and has no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem: 'Shares to redeem' as an ERY amount, 'To' the receiver, and 'Owner'. The screen does not name EURe or give an amount.

findings.title: redeem never names EURe as the asset that the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` The redeem format has only `shares`, `receiver` and `owner`. Unlike the mint format, it has no field for the constant `underlyingTicker`.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and change the intent to "Redeem ERY for EURe".

findings.title: redeem does not show or bound the EURe amount the receiver gets; storage decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` No minimum-out parameter exists in calldata.
